prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single high-fidelity desktop web application screen for CommandGrid, a hackathon infrastructure recovery simulator. Render edge to edge in landscape 16:10 with crisp readable UI text, no browser frame, no device or desk. A static sample scenario, not a landing page or poster.
Direction C — recovery sequence. This concept must differ fundamentally from a map dashboard: NO MAP, NO GEOGRAPHIC TERRAIN. The operator follows an unfolding sequence of incidents, inspects one disruption and executes the next recovery step. Lead with an expansive event history that has a clear vertical chronology, timestamps, incident titles, short outcome explanations and measured intervals. Selected event: “03:39 Power failure — Juniper Power Station”; earlier event “03:12 Communications restored — North Haven Relay”; earlier “02:48 Equipment diagnostic — Cedar Support Center”. A precise continuous telemetry chart aligned with the event times makes cause and effect legible. The right work area contains the selected incident, affected system Power, and recovery option “Activate backup power”, cost “8 resources”, strong button “Execute action”. Lower summary lists the three facilities and their status, plus objective “Restore power”.
Art direction: rich aubergine ink background with soft chalk text, muted lilac chart rules, tangerine reserved for selected incident/action and amber status. Refined condensed sans headings, clean humanist UI labels and elegant tabular numerals. A sophisticated, flat, sharply structured workspace, calm density and purposeful negative space; no glow or glass. One dominant editorial timeline composition with quiet supporting regions.
Complete framing: simple text CommandGrid; horizontal navigation Dashboard / Mission Builder / Objectives / Mission Control / Reports, Mission Control active. Page title “Communications Recovery”. Status Running; elapsed “03:42 / 10:00”; Pause. Restrained health strip Communications 82%, Equipment 75%, Power 64%, Resources 58%. Include “Sample scenario”. Finish the entire working interface within the screen with no cut-off panels. Do not add success probabilities, invented product claims, testimonials, badges, fake code terminals, branding symbols, game effects or hero slogans. Awwwards-level compositional craft with Impeccable task hierarchy.
